## Summary

Completes deterministic first-release Editor Visual Validation for ADR0136, ADR0137, ADR0138, ADR0139, ADR0144, ADR0149, and ADR0153 on current main.

This follow-up preserves the Animation Set regression tests while removing the mid-file test module structure that trips `clippy::items_after_test_module` under the required full workspace lint gate. No lint suppression is added.

Supersedes Draft PR #774 and the older #673 implementation branch; do not merge both.
